title: Build Agent semantic_checks.json
description: Structured output of the semantic anomaly checklist run during /start-build-run. Lives at state/run_id_<ID>/discovery/semantic_checks.json. Missing file blocks phase transition to /analyze-inputs.

checks.description: One entry per check_id defined in references/input_validation.md. Every check must be represented even if status is n/a.

detail.description: One-sentence human-readable summary. Required when status is flagged.

n_a_reason.description: Why the check is not applicable. Required when status is n/a.

evidence_refs.description: Pointers to evidence in input documents. Required when status is flagged.

recommended_action.description: What /start-build-run should propose to the user when this check is flagged.

resolution.description: Populated after the user's checkpoint decision. Surfaces in the assumptions register during packaging.

source_file.description: Path relative to inputs/ — e.g., user_instructions.md, STTM.xlsx, business_rules.md.

location.description: Section / sheet / cell / row reference — e.g., 'section: Must-Follow Rules', 'sheet: f_sales, row 12', 'line 45'.

excerpt.description: Optional short quote from the source for traceability.
